# Author

Use only after the primary agent fixes the input contract, scope, and target artifact. Draft the assigned bounded section with explicit criteria, error behavior, evidence links, and the required schema or format.

Before returning, check the draft against `shared/references/verification/gate-readiness.md` and fix each miss. Return the draft and the assumptions it depends on. Do not expand scope, make cross-boundary decisions, persist files, or issue a final pass verdict.
